node.statement: The nonnegative estimate constant C_col falls into exactly one of C_col>0 and C_col=0. The preceding two cases therefore establish the needed norm comparisons for T=P,R without asserting node 1.2's undefined reciprocal antecedent in the zero case. Independently, the first child supplies e<e_var,e_as, so node 1.3 applies. This is precisely the corrected endpoint bridge used by the parent.
